# PERSYM1 results — generated by `mktables_persym.py`, do not hand-edit

15 confirmations, each run once. Luck bar √(2·ln 15) = **2.327**.
Track E is diagnostic and excluded from the count.

## A. Exit management at +0.8R (OQ2) — paired on identical trades

Entries are unselected (every eligible 60m RTH bar, direction fixed by the prior bar) so the exit policy is the only thing varying. `be08` moves the stop to the fill once a bar has traded +0.8R without touching the stop, effective the next bar. `x08` exits fully at +0.8R. Differences are per-trade and paired, so entry quality cancels exactly.

| `golden_limit2` | 24 | 10.63 | $106 | **under** | 14 | 10 | $49,827.96 | +0.2379 |
| `golden_limit4` | 24 | 10.63 | $106 | **under** | 14 | 10 | $49,648.91 | +0.1589 |

| `golden_market` | 33 | 20.41 | $204 | over | 6 | 27 | $50,392.17 | +0.4324 |

| `only_0786_limit4` | 9 | 13.31 | $133 | over | 3 | 6 | $50,145.54 | +0.8226 |

The 2-bar and 4-bar limit windows differ by exactly one trade (bar 11306 fills only at the wider window and then blocks bar 11309 under one-position-at-a-time); every shared trade is identical, and nothing fills beyond 4 bars. So the gap between those rows is one trade in 26, not a window effect.
